description: Train a model: start a training run on an approved dataset, paid upfront from Cloud credits for the hours you choose. Needs a key with the "spend" permission, max_usd and idempotency_key.

base_model.description: Base model id from the training catalog

budget_hours.description: Hours to prepay (billed in whole hours)

computeApiKey.description: Singularity Cloud API key with the "spend" permission (cloud.x402compute.cc > Settings > API keys).

gpu_plan_id.description: GPU id from the training catalog

idempotency_key.description: A new unique id per purchase (8 to 128 letters, digits, . _ : -). Repeating a purchase with the SAME id never charges twice.

max_usd.description: The most you agree to pay, in US dollars. Refused before any charge if the price is higher.

name: cloud_start_training_run
